segments.en: By day 17, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "authentication" and "authorization" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "I don't feel well." and "I have a headache." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "access token" and "personal access token" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.
